findings.issue: `step_check_convergence` presents its numbered list as the script's complete order ('The script applies this fixed order, first match wins'), but the list stops at the `minIterations` floor (item 5) and jumps to the quality guards (item 6). `convergence.cjs` runs one more stage between them: when `depthMode` is expansive and `frontierOpen > 0`, the candidate becomes `CONTINUE` with reasonDetail `frontierOpen` (convergence.cjs:1188-1197). The omission is load-bearing because this same file relies on that stage at line 1269 ('The frontierOpen stop veto already returns CONTINUE while one is open, so this gate records the order'), and both research references list the veto (convergence.md:136 item 7, quick-reference.md:120). A reader of the workflow's own ordered list cannot place the expansive stop veto, and the workflow advertises an order that is one stage short.

The review feature page says admission applies 'depth, fan-out, budget, dedupe and cycle caps', naming five checks and omitting `relevance`, which the code runs first. `checkProposal` prunes as `relevance` a proposal with no `evidence`, an empty `scope`, a scope outside a file-list review target, or a `parentId` the store does not hold (frontier-admit.cjs:309-319) before any cap is tested. The review packet contradicts itself: SKILL.md:240 and README.md:158 both state six checks in order including relevance, and the research counterpart was corrected to the same six-check sentence. An operator reading only the feature page sees an admission gate that cannot reject an evidence-less or dangling-parent proposal.

findings.issue: The scenario makes 'exactly three new iteration files' a pass condition (also line 27 'adds exactly three iterations' and line 63 'exactly three new iterations'), but `--extend=N` only raises `maxIterations` to (runs so far + N) and resets `status` to initialized; the next stop decision still sees the prior converged state. Under the default `stopPolicy: convergence` the extension step itself warns the run 'may re-stop on all_questions_answered right away' (deep-research.yaml:560), and command 4 passes no `--convergence-mode=off`, so a cap-stopped run whose questions are already answered can spend zero or one pass and the scenario reports FAIL for correct code. The review counterpart (extend-completed-review-run.md:31) repeats the same unconditional criterion.
